correctness.rationale: Map every edge of boundary cross-polytope to a pair of distinct signed coordinates: precisely four alternative signed choices above each pair of K_d; disjointness and cross-polytope face condition are exactly Infl_4(M_d). The published vertex inflation homotopy splitting and known M7 integral H1=Z/3, H2=Z^20 combine with 21*3*6+105*9*2+105*27=5103 extra S2 to give H2 rank 5123. Small M_d links are torsion-free for d<=6. Deflation p to M7 has plus-sign section, identifies first integral H1; sign flips commute with p and act trivially. Independent exact mod3 chain reconstruction of all 105 triangle columns gives rank 84, a five-edge nonboundary cycle z, and 32-triangle witness certifying tau z=-z modulo boundaries, so all transpositions act -1. For order-two quotient, characteristic 3 transfer/averaging identifies quotient homology with invariants, which vanish in degree one. Mod3 computations do not by themselves prove integral torsion: that is supplied by the cited M7 result.

value.rationale: Identifies the full natural signed-coordinate action on the first torsion of a geometrically canonical shellable flag sphere double, distinguishing a sign character from the trivial module and yielding a concrete quotient-homology consequence. The pre-existing nonequivariant inflation splitting and torsion groups are acknowledged, while the explicit equivariant torsion character and finite witness supply the motivated additional fact.

final_claim: For the simplicial double of a d-dimensional cross-polytope boundary, first torsion occurs at d=7 with Htilde1=Z/3, Htilde2=Z^5123; W7 acts on Htilde1 by S7 permutation sign, and quotient by a coordinate transposition has zero H1(F3).
limitations: Only first torsion occurrence d=7 and H1 character, not higher-degree module or general doubled-sphere classification.
